mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring a specific trigger condition.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 2.0% and remains below that level for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days through a joint demand signal.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100k signals labor market strength that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150000, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100k per month indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring a specific trigger.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth > 100k, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad economic strength that boosts corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days through a joint demand signal.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% year-over-year), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
